name: KOTOR II
description: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II loader for PlayStation Vita
long_description: This is an experimental native loader for the Android release of KOTOR II. It loads the original ARM shared libraries from a user-supplied copy of the game, maps their platform APIs to Vita implementations, renders through vitaGL, and provides a custom FMOD audio backend over sceAudiodec and sceAudioOut.
requirements:
- A Vita or PS TV capable of running HENkaku/taiHEN.
- kubridge.skprx installed and enabled as a taiHEN plugin.
- libshacccg.suprx in ur0:data/ for runtime shader compilation.
- About 4 GB free on ux0: for the tested game data. The exact requirement depends on the Android release and optional restored-content files.
